rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload condition and set M191 alarm flag
Reset general fault latch M190 via reset pushbutton X1
Evaluate cell fault and safety interlock summary M199
Energize ST10 conveyor motor contactor Y10 in auto mode when interlock is clear
Flag pallet in position M100 from stop photo-eye X10
Latch stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of line controller release request
Run 2.0 s release pulse timer T11 while stopper release solenoid is energized
Reset stopper release solenoid Y11 when pulse timer T11 elapses
